scenario_description:
Objective: Strengthen Prairie Link’s renewal-readiness narrative with an optional customer-visibility mention tied to winter operations adoption.
Emerging Need: A late newsletter tile is useful only if a relevant account story, a reversible nomination path, and the proper communications route align before roster export.
Decision Context: Routine review planning and a broad marketing opening become actionable after account chatter identifies a timely success angle and the roster limit narrows the viable window.
Consequence: If the window passes, the account review and newsletter still proceed normally, but the chance to offer Prairie Link timely positive exposure disappears.

parameter.title: Prairie Link renewal readiness agenda prep
parameter.description: Prepare standard Q1 renewal-readiness agenda and account-health notes before next week's Prairie Link check-in.

parameter.subject: One late customer-visibility tile open for January transit newsletter
parameter.body: Customer Programs has one no-cost customer-visibility tile open in the January newsletter theme on winter service adaptation. If a CS team has a suitable agency candidate, we can hold a provisional spot with just the agency name by 14:40 CT today; approved quotes or artwork can follow next week. If no candidate fits, we'll fill the tile with an internal product tip.

parameter.content: Quick note from today's Prairie Link check-in: their dispatch trainer sounded genuinely proud of how the winter spare-board dashboard reduced scramble during the first snow week. No action needed for the check-in agenda, but it could be a nice customer-success proof point if a public-friendly opening appears.

parameter.title: Customer Programs provisional tile roster cutoff
parameter.content: Customer Programs roster closes at 14:40 CT. Provisional holds need only an agency name; no quote text, artwork, pricing discussion, or commitment is due today.

parameter.subject: January customer-visibility tile roster exported
parameter.body: The January newsletter roster exported at 15:00 CT. We cannot add late customer candidates to this run, so the unused tile is now assigned to the internal product-tip fallback.
